language_notes: Graduate School general IELTS Academic requirement for full enrollment is overall 7.0, with minimum 7.0 in Reading, Listening, and Writing and 6.5 in Speaking. This is not by itself a guarantee of admission: the page says individual programs may impose stricter requirements. TOEFL iBT and PTE Academic are alternatives; scores in lower ranges may lead to English-course conditions. Exemptions include qualifying degrees from a regionally accredited U.S. institution or recognized institution in a listed English-speaking country, subject to the Graduate School's conditions (including in-country study; online/foreign branch study does not qualify). MAGE directs international applicants to these requirements; verify applicable current proof rules with the program.
scholarships_note: No named scholarship with verified eligibility for international MEng Cybersecurity students was established from the official pages reviewed. MAGE says its MEng programs provide no financial assistance and no departmental assistantships or fellowships; do not assume funding is available or guaranteed.
